changes.1.1: Track 1 corpora deduplicated: documents with identical text (after collapsing whitespace) are reduced to one copy. Gold IDs are always kept; when several gold IDs share one text they are merged into one. Removed IDs map to the kept ID in track1_tempo/<domain>/duplicate_map.json. Queries, steps, splits and gold texts are unchanged; all guidance annotations are kept. Track 2 is unchanged.

split.note: Corpora are never split; retrieval uses the full domain corpus. Track 1b steps and reformulation variants follow their parent query.

dedup.match: identical text ignoring whitespace (runs of whitespace collapsed, leading/trailing stripped); any other difference, including punctuation, keeps documents separate
dedup.kept_id: an ID referenced by a task file (qrels, gold_ids, guidance) if the group has one, else the lexicographically smallest ID; smallest referenced ID when several are referenced
dedup.task_files: removed IDs are renamed to the kept ID in qrels, examples, steps and guidance; ID lists and qrels that then name one document twice keep the first occurrence; guidance gold_passage_annotations are never dropped, so 36 records hold more than one annotation for the same doc_id (53 extra annotations)
